subject: Vendor Onboarding: CloudData Inc. — PO and spend-cap request
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@clouddata.io>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor Onboarding: CloudData Inc. — PO and spend-cap request

Hi Monica,

Thanks for taking this on. I'm starting the vendor setup for CloudData Inc. — attached is our completed onboarding form and an initial SOW line-item export. Can you confirm the information you need from procurement so we can get a PO number issued? We typically request a 30-day net payment term and an initial spend cap while we start integration.

Attachments: CloudData_onboarding_form_v3.pdf (vendor form), CloudData_lineitems_v1.xlsx (line items)

High-level ask: PO number + confirmation of spend cap for Q3 integration (estimate ~$40k).

If helpful, I can reformat the line items to match your template.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Partnerships
CloudData Inc.
elena@clouddata.io
+1 (415) 555-0183
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@clouddata.io>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor Onboarding: CloudData Inc. — PO and spend-cap request

Hi Elena — thanks for the form and the line items. Quick notes from procurement (see inline):

- We need the vendor legal name and W-9/TIN on the onboarding form (left blank on page 2).
- Line items: we require GL coding per our PO template — I've attached PO_template_v2.xlsx for your team to map the items to our budget codes.
- Spend cap: procurement proposes an initial cap of $150,000 for the first quarter while we run integration and measure usage; finance will sign off on the exact amount. If CloudData needs a lower cap to start, confirm and we can set a revision cadence.
- Terms: Net-30 is OK; we typically require invoices to reference the PO number and line-item codes.

Can you resend the onboarding form with W-9/TIN filled and update the Excel using the PL/GL columns in the attached template? Once finance confirms the cap I can request a PO number.

Attachments: PO_template_v2.xlsx

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@clouddata.io>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@clouddata.io
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor Onboarding: CloudData Inc. — PO and spend-cap request

Monica — attached the updated onboarding form with TIN and the corrected line items mapped to your PO template columns. I also added a short description column to clarify deliverables per line item.

Couple of notes:
- We can start with a $50k initial cap to align with your request for a conservative rollout; we'll track usage and request increases through the Redwood procurement portal.
- Requested payment terms: Net-30 as discussed.
- Preferred invoice email: accounts@clouddata.io (please include PO number on invoices).

Attachments: CloudData_onboarding_form_v3_filled.pdf, CloudData_lineitems_corrected.xlsx

Let me know if anything else is outstanding and if you can provision a PO number so we can schedule kickoff next week.

Best,
Elena
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Vendor Onboarding: CloudData Inc. — PO and spend-cap request

Monica — finance reviewed the updated forms. We can approve an initial spend cap of $150,000 for the quarter, but since CloudData asked to start at $50k, let's set an execution plan: finance will encode a hard internal cap of $150k in the system and set a monitored soft cap at $50k for alerts. That way procurement can issue the PO and we can increment in two steps.

Proposed PO number (placeholder until signed): PO-2025-0742
Please confirm and route the attached PO to CloudData for signature (DocuSign link preferred). Also confirm the billing code: IT-ML-INF-23 so we can map spend to the right budget line.

— Marcus
VP, Finance (FP&A)
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@clouddata.io>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor Onboarding: CloudData Inc. — PO and spend-cap request

Elena — thanks for the quick turn. We have internal approval to proceed. Next steps:

1) PO issuance: Your PO number is PO-2025-0742 (attached signed PDF). This covers the initial quarter with a system hard cap of $150,000 and a monitored soft cap at $50,000 — finance will alert both teams when soft cap is hit.
2) Billing instructions: Invoices should reference the PO number and the billing code IT-ML-INF-23. Send invoices to accounts@clouddata.io as you noted.
3) Line items: I reviewed the CloudData_lineitems_corrected.xlsx and confirmed mapping to our GL codes. I made two minor corrections to the quantity for line items 3 and 7 (see redlines in the attached).
4) Contract & signature: DocuSign envelope for the PO is at https://app.docusign.com/PO-2025-0742 — please sign the PO and return. We've attached PO-2025-0742_signed.pdf (copy for your records).

Attachments: PO-2025-0742_signed.pdf, CloudData_lineitems_corrected.xlsx (redlined)

If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute kickoff Wednesday to confirm integration milestones tied to spend.

Thanks and welcome aboard — excited to get this integrated.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0122
